description: Production bug fixed and deployed — checkpoint should reflect the fix, not the ongoing incident
prior_summary: Race condition in token refresh service causing intermittent 401 errors in production. Root cause identified in refresh_token() — lock not held during concurrent requests. Fix designed but not yet merged or deployed.

thread_items.content: PR was approved, go ahead and merge
Merged and deployed to production. Monitoring shows 401 error rate back to baseline. The fix adds a distributed lock around the refresh operation to prevent concurrent token refresh races.

carried_conclusions.text: Race condition in refresh_token() caused by missing lock during concurrent requests

selected_work_artifacts.text: Merged and deployed to production. 401 error rate back to baseline.

description: Long uncertain discussion ends in a clear decision — checkpoint should reflect the decision, not the earlier uncertainty
prior_summary: Caching strategy for API responses unresolved. Redis vs in-memory cache under active debate. Redis adds ops overhead, in-memory doesn't survive restarts. No consensus reached. Decision needed before implementation can proceed.

thread_items.content: given the restart issue, let's just go with Redis

Decision confirmed: Redis for API response caching. Added redis-py dependency, implemented cache_response() helper with 5-minute TTL. Cache warms on first request per endpoint. All tests passing, implementation complete.

carried_conclusions.text: Redis chosen for API response caching due to restart persistence requirement over in-memory option

selected_work_artifacts.text: Redis caching implementation complete. cache_response() with 5-minute TTL. Tests passing.
